list_projects.description: Your active projects, optionally only those matching a name or a client. Each comes with (beta) the estimate set for it in Toggl Track, all the hours tracked to it so far, the hours left and the percentage used, as numbers and as text ready for a message (85%, 12.5 hours left), so no other source of estimates and no calculation step is needed. Used at least (% of estimate) keeps only the projects that have reached that share of their estimate, and Hours from adds each project's hours for a period such as this week. Estimates are a paid Toggl Track feature: a project without one has those fields empty, and is left out when Used at least is set, so on a plan without estimates that filter lists nothing (count is 0).
list_projects.name: list_projects

parameters.description: Only projects whose name contains this. An exact match comes first.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Only this client's projects.
parameters.name: client_id

parameters.description: Also list archived projects. Default: No, so only active projects are listed.
parameters.name: include_archived

parameters.description: (beta) Only projects that have used at least this percentage of their estimated hours, counting all time tracked to the project so far: 80 lists the projects at 80% or more, including those over 100%. This replaces working out percentages and filtering in later steps. Projects without an estimate in Toggl Track are left out when this is set. Leave empty to list every project.
parameters.name: min_percent_used

parameters.description: (beta) Pick a period to also get, on each project, the hours the whole team tracked to it in that period, as a number and as text ready for a message (12.5 hours): this week so far, last week, this month so far or last month. Weeks run Monday to Sunday, in your Toggl Track time zone. This replaces working out the week's first day in earlier steps. It doesn't change which projects are listed, or the estimate figures, which always count all time so far. Use Hours from instead for any other dates; fill in one or the other, not both.
parameters.name: hours_period

parameters.description: (beta) Fill this in to also get, on each project, the hours the whole team tracked to it from this day on (its hours in the period), for example Monday of this week. It doesn't change which projects are listed, or the estimate figures, which always count all time so far. Leave empty to skip it.
parameters.name: from_date

parameters.description: (beta) The last day of that period. Leave empty for today. Only used with Hours from.
parameters.name: to_date

description: Start and stop timers, log and edit time entries, report hours by project, client or team member, and keep Toggl Track projects and clients up to date.

toggl_track_new_time_entry_trigger.description: Runs for each new Toggl Track time entry of yours, a timer you start included, with its description, project, tags and start, for one project or all of them. Entries already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It checks every 15 minutes at most, to stay inside Toggl Track's hourly limit.

output.duration_hours: How long it lasted, in hours, such as 1.5.
output.duration_seconds: How long it lasted (so far), in seconds.
output.duration_text: How long it lasted, such as 1:30:00.
output.end: When it ended (UTC); empty while the timer runs.
output.id: The time entry's Toggl id, for Update or Delete time entry.
output.project_id: The project's id, if it has one.
output.running: True while the timer is still running.
output.workspace_id: The workspace the entry is in.

parameters.description: Only watch time tracked to this project. Leave empty to watch all your time.
parameters.name: project_id

toggl_track_time_entry_finished_trigger.description: Runs for each of your Toggl Track time entries once it has an end: a timer you stop, or time you log afterwards, with how long it lasted, for one project or all of them. Entries finished before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It checks every 15 minutes at most, to stay inside Toggl Track's hourly limit.

output.duration_hours: How long it lasted, in hours, such as 1.5.
output.duration_seconds: How long it lasted (so far), in seconds.
output.duration_text: How long it lasted, such as 1:30:00.
output.end: When it ended (UTC); empty while the timer runs.
output.id: The time entry's Toggl id, for Update or Delete time entry.
output.project_id: The project's id, if it has one.
output.running: True while the timer is still running.
output.workspace_id: The workspace the entry is in.
